# PMI 8 Process Map

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

This is the canonical index for the 40 nonprescriptive PMBOK Guide 8th Edition processes. The five focus areas classify the process work; they do not define the execution pipeline.

## Routing

Load the process recipe by domain from `references/processes/`. If a PMI source is supplied, load only the selected process and tailoring sections needed for the project context. Use `stages/01-select-and-tailor/CONTEXT.md` to choose the process and use the five stage contracts to execute it.
